exact_evidence_grounding.rationale: Finding 1 causal_link cites E-042 and E-041 although only E-012 is declared as finding evidence; finding 1 also attaches C-005 without evidence overlap.

claim_atomicity.rationale: Claims 1 and 2 are reasonably atomic; finding 3 bundles a reliability incident judgment with a scope critique of peak-event uptime, reducing crispness without triggering the deterministic contrastive-claim rule.

claim_target_alignment.rationale: Only finding 2 directly tests switching friction. Finding 1 stops at architecture without economic consequence, while finding 3 elevates service reliability above stronger packet evidence on product economics and competitive replicability.

support_counterevidence_polarity.rationale: E-056 is a positive peak-uptime claim used as support for a negative reliability claim instead of being treated as opposing or qualifying evidence; C-005 counterevidence is also not explicitly routed through counterevidence_ids.

qualification_orthogonality.rationale: Finding 1 surfaces the E-012 limitation correctly, but finding 3 absorbs E-056's scope limitation into the claim instead of preserving it as an orthogonal evidence qualification.

conflict_handling.rationale: Finding 1 attaches C-005 to E-012 without overlap with C-005 evidence_refs; weak-link candidate E-043 also attaches C-004 although E-043 is not part of that conflict.

weak_link_usefulness.rationale: E-036 is a useful weak link because churn definition is underspecified. E-043 is weak evidence but is paired with unrelated conflict C-004, reducing diagnostic usefulness.

unresolved_point_usefulness.rationale: Questions 1 and 2 are actionable and directly tied to C-005 and C-004. Question 3 is useful but references C-010 with E-055 only, omitting the paired E-056 evidence needed to test the scoped reliability conflict.

judgment_boundary_compliance.rationale: No final moat conclusion, valuation conclusion, score, routing decision, or production authority is emitted.

priority_selection_usefulness.rationale: Priority selection underweights E-044/E-045/E-046 product-economic outcomes, E-057 infrastructure/licensing footprint, and E-051/E-052 competitor replicability while allocating one of three slots to a single service incident versus a peak-event metric.
